title: Actor
description: Pseudonymous reference to the principal that performed or requested an operation (Clarification 8: no email, display name or other free-text identity field). Used by ActionIntent, ApprovalDecision and AuditRecord. Derived server-side from validated identity; never taken from a request body or model output.

principal_pseudonym.description: Stable pseudonym of the principal, as issued by the policy store. Re-identification is a policy-store concern, not a contract field.

on_behalf_of.description: Pseudonym of the user an agent, copilot or MCP client is acting for; null when the principal acts for itself.
